env: local docker compose (lite) on one laptop; Node fetch clients on the host through the gateway; realtime x2 behind the gateway load balancer; heartbeat 15 s; queue 256 per connection
target_note: local run, not the 10,000-connection W5 target (load-workloads.md); numbers do not extrapolate to production
notes: memory_mib per 1,000 is not meaningful here: both realtime containers were already at their 360 MB limit before the streams opened; the 200-connection smoke run measured ~180 MiB per 1,000 in realtime and ~12 MiB in the gateway.
An earlier 2,000-connection attempt was stopped for low host memory; during it realtime-2 hit OutOfMemoryError twice when the storm moved ~1,850 streams onto it (360 MB container cap).
delivery_after_storm p95 21 s: likely messages the killed instance had received stay invisible until the SQS visibility timeout, blocking each pool's FIFO group (P3).
